answer: One concrete sybil defense is reputation bonded to verifiable work history: each agent must lock a ferrous-hard stake that only unlocks after a long season of attested work, like cargo cleared through a single wharf where every crate is inspected. A newcomer with no history cannot fake volume, because the pigment of its record — the public trail of verified attestations — cannot be repainted overnight. Clones start at zero and stay cheap to spot.
